repeat-binder-gonogo — control run

Validating a Boltz-2 scoring pipeline against repeat-protein complexes with known outcomes, before trusting it on a novel design.

The verdict

This is a control run — every case below has a deposited structure or a published measurement already. Nothing here is a design target.

G2 FAIL
DARPin 4m3 scores 78.7 against its true target (mouse cathepsin B, 65.7 nM binder) and 39.7 against the 83%-identical human ortholog it does not bind — a 38.9-point margin in the right direction. But the model's own seed-to-seed noise on that second case spans 52.7 points. The margin does not clear the noise, so the gate the whole validation exists for reports fail, not a low pass.

All 15 scored cases

Higher score = stronger predicted interaction. Gray bracket = spread across 3 independent seeds of the same model — this is what G2's margin is judged against.

true binder true non-binder decoy (shuffled / non-cognate)

Predicted vs. deposited structure

The gate run only kept scores, not structures — these three were re-predicted (single seed) specifically to visualize. Aligned on the target chain only, so binder placement is the thing being compared, not overall fold.

Follow-up diagnostics

Neither of these amends the shipped G2 verdict above — they inform what fixing it would take.

G1 — interface recovery

not_run

DockQ was installed and run against all 8 Tier C structures. Every comparison errored inside DockQ's own PDB parser before producing a score — a structure-format mismatch to debug, not a missing dependency.

G2 at more seeds

still fail

Resampled B1/B4 to 12 seeds. The range-based band stays "fail" throughout; a Welch's-t confidence interval would flip to "pass" at n≥4. Evidence about the band definition, not permission to overturn G2.

G4 — calibration (exploratory)

pass · AUC 0.775

From the --ignore-veto sweep that bought Tier C despite G2 failing, to see what the remaining gates would say. Confidence is informative even though specificity isn't certified yet.

Reproduce: python -m gonogo --scorer boltz2 run then python -m gonogo verify. Structures regenerated for this page: demo/structures/. Full write-up: docs/gonogo-feasibility.md. Live PyMOL sessions (.pse) for hands-on rotation during the talk are in demo/structures/.
